Frequently Asked Questions

How long does it take to see SEO results?

SEO is a long-term strategy. Typically, you can start seeing noticeable improvements in local search rankings within 3 to 6 months, depending on competition and current website status.

Do you only work with businesses in Salem?

While I am based in Salem and specialize in the local market, I work with clients across Tamil Nadu and beyond to improve their local search presence in their respective areas.

What is included in a Google Business Profile Optimization?

It includes complete profile setup, accurate business information mapping, category optimization, managing reviews, updating photos/posts, and utilizing all available GBP features to maximize visibility.

Why do I need an SEO Audit?

An SEO audit acts as a health check for your website. It uncovers technical issues, on-page errors, and structural problems that might be preventing search engines from ranking your site effectively.

How do you measure success?

Success is measured through tangible metrics: increase in organic traffic, higher rankings for target keywords, growth in local map pack visibility, and most importantly, an increase in qualified leads and conversions.
